asr.full_text: How to Contact Facebook Customer Support Welcome to Marketing Fundars I am Ritesh Gupta and today I will tell you, how you can contact facebook customer support and it is very important because we sometimes have no option how we can getting the situation for all the problems in face books so it will give you a definite solution so that you can also contact Facebook customer support and you can directly with them live so let's move to a computer screen to login into your Facebook account and you must have your Business Manager account you can see here business manager so as I told you in the earlier videos you must have your business manager account to run ads on Facebook or do advertisement or if you want to run facebook ads or do advertisement or you want to grow your business so after making your business manager account then only you can talk to or contact customer care so if you are not having that account so please go into our channel and see business manager tutorial so please click Business Manager program. So please start and click on your Business Manager account. After clicking on your Business Manager account, you have to choose a business in which you are having some issues or trouble. So now you can see there are question symbol in bottom, help center, so you have to click here, now you can see this is business.Facebook.com slash business.help. You can copy this URL also. And now you can, you can see here find answers or contact support so you have to click on get started now there are three to five to six options and if your problem is related to billing you can click here related to ads so you can click on ads and now you can see there is here you see chat with representative click on here in which you are facing some issue and a page I am selecting this page okay so here you have to select the question like I am selecting this ad pollution disapproved ads so many of us face this problem our ads are getting disapproved. So I am selecting this Here, you can select if you are finding your issue or otherwise, you can click on others. This area is optional You can move further just click on start chat Now you can see after clicking on start chat This will take us to Facebook Messenger. section and now here I can check with the representative like you can see a facebook representative will join you shortly and now you can see here and we can just right like hi my facing so choose and I am just send them now you can see they will answer me I hope you like this video and now you will also chat with face book customer support and get the solution for your problems so if you had any problem then you can comment in the section about this Can also directly Chad with Facebook customer support and get the solution for their problems So if you are having any problem Coming in a section and our team will support you for new videos and updates Please like subscribe our channel.
